Sudhakaran 2025:Ker:20674 Crl.Mc No. 9137 Of 2023 2 Respondent/State & Complainant: 1 State Of Kerala Represented By The Public Prosecutor, High Court Of Kerala, Ernakulam, Pin - 682031. 2 The Food Safety Officer Manjeri Circle, Malappuram, Pin - 676121. Sri.Grashious Kuriakose Sri .M.C. Ashi, Pp. This Criminal Misc. Case Having Come Up For Admission On 11.03.2025, The Court On The Same Day Passed The Following: 2025:Ker:20674 Crl.Mc No. 9137 Of 2023 3 Order
texts.facts: Petitioners are accused Nos.3 to 6 in C.C No.1041 of 2023 on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Manjeri. The case originated from a complaint filed by the Food Safety Officer alleging that the samples of Dalda Vanaspati collected from the accused was reported to be unsafe for human consumption by the Regional Analytical Laboratory as it contained 'Nickel' in excess of permissible limit. At the same time, as per the report of the Referral Food Laboratory, Mysore, second sample received for analysis contained 'Lead' in excess of the permissible limit, while the Nickel content was within limits. This Crl.M.C is filed seeking to quash the proceedings in view of the divergent findings in the two reports.
texts.arguments: 2. Learned counsel for the petitioners relied on the 2025:KER:20674 decision of this Court in Pepsico India Holdings Pvt. Ltd v. State of Kerala [2024 (6) KHC 251] to contend that the divergent findings of two laboratories is sufficient reason for this Court to quash the proceedings. As held by this Court in Pepsico India Holdings Pvt. Ltd (supra), prosecution steps can be initiated only if the report of the Food Analyst Laboratory is confirmed by the Referral Laboratory.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 2. Learned counsel for the petitioners relied on the 2025:KER:20674 decision of this Court in Pepsico India Holdings Pvt. Ltd v. State of Kerala [2024 (6) KHC 251] to contend that the divergent findings of two laboratories is sufficient reason for this Court to quash the proceedings.
texts.other_lawyer_arguments: As held by this Court in Pepsico India Holdings Pvt. Ltd (supra), prosecution steps can be initiated only if the report of the Food Analyst Laboratory is confirmed by the Referral Laboratory.
